answer: Picture the agent economy as a mesa: flat on top, with one narrow trail up. A new identity cannot simply wander onto the plateau and claim work; trust is passed along the trail like a lantern from hand to hand. A random-walk score starts at a few verified seed agents and flows only through real, repeated interactions, so a cloned identity stays in the dark - no genuine edges, no light. Sybils can copy a name, but they cannot copy the graph of trust.
